cardEffects:
[Trash] [All Turns] When one of your [DoruGreymon] would be deleted, by digivolving it into this card without paying the cost, prevent that deletion.
[When Digivolving] Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, ＜Draw 1＞. If [DoruGreymon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or this digivolved from the trash, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less instead.
inheritedEffect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may choose 1 of your Digimon. Delete 1 of your chosen Digimon and 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a level equal to or lower than that Digimon.
name: DexDoruGreymon

rulings.answer: It triggers at the timing when this card is in the trash and your [DoruGreymon] would be deleted.  [Trash] means that an effect can trigger and activate when the card is in the trash.
rulings.question: When exactly is the timing when this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect triggers?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  However, the DP-reducing effect will be carried over after the [DoruGreymon] effect activates and digivolution occurs, therefore deletion will occur again if the DP is still 0 after the effect activates and digivolution occurs.
rulings.question: If I use this card's [Trash] effect to digivolve when my [DoruGreymon] would be deleted by its DP becoming 0, can I prevent that deletion?

rulings.answer: No, you can't activate it.  The Digimon is deleted before the [When Digivolving] effect activates.
rulings.question: I used this card's [Trash] effect to digivolve when my [DoruGreymon] would be deleted due to its DP being reduced by 10000. Its DP became 0 due to the DP-reducing effect, but can I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect after it digivolves at such times?
Does "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less instead" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate instead of "Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, ＜Draw 1＞."?
Can I use this card’s inherited effect to choose my Digimon with a "can't be deleted by effects" effect and only delete an opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as that Digimon?
